_comment: Axiom APL for the PRL dashboard. {DS} is replaced with the dataset name. live = refreshed every 30 s, slow = every 5 min. Each query returns rows; worker.js turns them into the page data.

readings.apl: ['{DS}'] | where _time > ago(15m) and isnull(source) and isnull(probe) | extend msg = replace_regex(@'\x1b\[[0-9;]*[A-Za-z]', '', tostring(['log.message'])) | extend ths = coalesce(toreal(extract(@'#\d+\s+.*?(\d+\.?\d*)\s*TH/s', 1, msg)), toreal(extract(@'pearl hashrate (\d+\.?\d*)th', 1, msg)), toreal(extract(@'Total: (\d+\.?\d*) TH/s', 1, msg))) | extend gpu = case(msg matches regex @'^\|\s*\w+:\d+\s*\|\s*gfx[0-9a-f]+\s*\|', extract(@'(gfx[0-9a-f]+)', 1, msg), msg contains 'GPU arch:', extract(@'GPU arch:\s*(gfx[0-9a-f]+)', 1, msg), msg matches regex @'#\d+\s+(NVIDIA |GeForce )?(RTX|GTX)', extract(@'#\d+\s+(.+?)\s+[\d.]+\s*[KMGTP]?H/s', 1, msg), msg contains '=== GPU: ', extract(@'=== GPU: (.+?) ===', 1, msg), '') | extend watts = toreal(extract(@'TH/s\s+(\d+\.?\d*)W', 1, msg)), temp = toint(extract(@'W\s+[\d.]+\s+\S+\s+(\d+)C', 1, msg)), mhz = toint(extract(@'(\d+)C\s+(\d+)\s+\d+', 2, msg)) | where isnotnull(ths) or gpu != '' | project _time, m = tostring(['resource.labels.machine_id']), g = tostring(['resource.labels.container_group_name']), ths, gpu, watts, temp, mhz | take 5000

activity.apl: ['{DS}'] | where _time > ago(15m) and isnull(source) and isnull(probe) and ['resource.labels.container_group_name'] != 'local-shiptest' | summarize last = max(_time), lines = count(), ver = make_set(tostring(['resource.labels.image_version'])), via = make_set(tostring(via)) by m = tostring(['resource.labels.machine_id']), g = tostring(['resource.labels.container_group_name'])

pool_workers.apl: ['{DS}'] | where source == 'kryptex' and kind == 'worker' and _time > ago(10m) | summarize arg_max(_time, ths_30m, ths_3h, ths_24h, status, valid, stale) by machine

balance.apl: ['{DS}'] | where source == 'kryptex' and kind == 'balance' and _time > ago(10m) | top 1 by _time desc | project _time, paid_prl, unpaid_prl, total_prl, reward_week_prl, workers_online, workers_total, pool_ths_30m, net_hashrate_phs, block_reward_prl

shares.apl: ['{DS}'] | where _time > ago(65m) and isnull(source) and isnull(probe) | extend msg = replace_regex(@'\x1b\[[0-9;]*[A-Za-z]', '', tostring(['log.message'])) | extend cnt = coalesce(toint(extract(@'shares=(\d+)', 1, msg)), toint(extract(@'Total:.*?(\d+) accepted', 1, msg))), acc = iff(msg contains 'share accepted', 1, 0) | where isnotnull(cnt) or acc == 1 | project _time, m = tostring(['resource.labels.machine_id']), cnt, acc | take 10000

share_diff.apl: ['{DS}'] | where _time > ago(65m) and isnull(source) and isnull(probe) | extend diff = toreal(extract(@'(?:pool difficulty|diff) ([\d.]+)P', 1, replace_regex(@'\x1b\[[0-9;]*[A-Za-z]', '', tostring(['log.message'])))) | where isnotnull(diff) | summarize arg_max(_time, diff) by m = tostring(['resource.labels.machine_id'])

events.apl: ['{DS}'] | where _time > ago(24h) and isnull(source) and isnull(probe) | extend msg = tostring(['log.message']) | where msg startswith '===' and msg matches regex @'host check|HOST IS|pool check: (no|TLS handshake works)|asking Salad|reallocation|exited|no accepted|ACCEPTED SHARE|starting:|no miner|image version' | project _time, m = tostring(['resource.labels.machine_id']), g = tostring(['resource.labels.container_group_name']), msg | sort by _time desc | take 60

fleet_trend.apl: ['{DS}'] | where _time > ago(24h) and isnull(source) and isnull(probe) | extend msg = replace_regex(@'\x1b\[[0-9;]*[A-Za-z]', '', tostring(['log.message'])) | extend ths = coalesce(toreal(extract(@'#\d+\s+.*?(\d+\.?\d*)\s*TH/s', 1, msg)), toreal(extract(@'pearl hashrate (\d+\.?\d*)th', 1, msg)), toreal(extract(@'Total: (\d+\.?\d*) TH/s', 1, msg))) | where isnotnull(ths) | summarize a = avg(ths) by t = bin(_time, 10m), m = tostring(['resource.labels.machine_id']) | summarize ths = round(sum(a), 1), workers = count() by t | sort by t asc

pool_trend.apl: ['{DS}'] | where source == 'kryptex' and kind == 'balance' and _time > ago(24h) | summarize pool_ths_30m = max(pool_ths_30m), total_prl = max(total_prl), workers_online = max(workers_online) by t = bin(_time, 10m) | sort by t asc
